messages:
Maria F: Heads-up — ACME asked for a per-line breakout on their private VPC invoice. They want: GPU license fees, cloud GPU hours (reserved vs on-demand), NAT egress, and KMS/HSM charges separated. They said current invoice is confusing. Can infra confirm what we actually pass through vs what we absorb?

Ajay I: @Maria F thanks. Short answer: we pass through the cloud instance/GPU usage + cloud egress + KMS when customer uses their KMS. We invoice Redwood license/managed service separately unless contract says pass-through.

Todd Ops: To add, for Dedicated/Private setups we try to map commitments — if the customer has reserved capacity in our Dedicated pool, the per-hour cost is our committed rate, not the cloud list price. That can change invoice lines depending on how we attribute hours.

Priya Billing: Real-world ask: ACME wants line items like `GPU-hours (us-west2, nvidia-a100): $X`, `GPU-license: $Y`, `NAT egress: $Z`. They also asked for a delta between reserved-commitment discount and list price. Can we provide that breakdown? :thinking:

Ajay I: We can provide those lines but note: showing "discount delta" implies exposing our internal committed pricing to the customer. If ACME is entitled to pass-through at cost, we can show the raw cloud invoice lines we forwarded. For committed pool, we can show an allocated unit cost but not the underlying vendor contract.

Ken S: If they want exact cloud invoice numbers, the safe route is to attach the vendor invoice PDF as a supporting document and mark it "for audit". Otherwise we provide an allocation table: compute hours by region + effective unit price we charged.

Maria F: Good point on audit docs. ACME is in enterprise tier with audit rights in contract, so they might expect vendor invoices. I'll confirm. Meanwhile, can infra provide a CSV mapping: timestamp, region, pool-type (dedicated/private), GPU-type, billed-hours, effective-unit-cost?

Ajay I: We already log usage in Prometheus/BigQuery. I can export a per-customer CSV but need to confirm how to compute "effective-unit-cost" for mixed pools (reserved + burst). Proposed algorithm: prorate reserved commit across baseline hours, charge bursts at on-demand. CSV would include `charge_type` = reserved|burst|on-demand.

Priya Billing: That works. Also need to know how we handle license fee when customer brings their own model license vs Redwood-managed license. Do we pass the license fee?

Todd Ops: Typically license (Redwood product fee) is our SKU and non-pass-through. Third-party model license we can pass-through if customer asked and signed AO (agreement). For BYO model where they provide their own license keys and use our infra, there's no Redwood license to charge.

billing-bot: Invoice generator job finished for ACME: job_id=inv-2026-03-17-87, attachments available at https://billing.internal/acme/inv-2026-03-17-87.pdf

Maria F: Thanks @billing-bot. Can someone from infra drop the CSV export to the billing ticket before EOD? ACME wants it attached to Feb invoice query.

Ajay I: I'll drop the CSV. Quick note on NAT egress: in multi-tenant VPCs we sometimes aggregate egress across projects and then allocate by bytes transferred. If ACME is on a dedicated VPC with a dedicated NAT, we can pass true per-customer bytes. Otherwise we use weighted allocation by instance-hours.

Ken S: Also check whether KMS requests are billed per-API or a flat monthly key fee in their cloud region. Different clouds differ (GCP vs AWS). We'll need cloud invoice lines to reconcile.

Priya Billing: Action items I have: 1) Maria to confirm audit rights, 2) Ajay to upload CSV with `reserved|burst|on-demand` tags, 3) Ken to attach vendor invoice or note if redacted, 4) Billing to prepare customer-facing breakout with minimal sensitive internal pricing.

Maria F: I'll confirm audit clause and reply to ACME asking for short delay while we compile. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Todd Ops: One more edge: if ACME requested price protection for GPUs under a committed contract, we should tag those months and show zero volatility in effective unit cost. Otherwise our allocation may show month-to-month swings that cause them to escalate.

Ajay I: Noted. I'll normalize the CSV to include a `commitment_tag` field and show which hours were covered by a commitment ID.

Priya Billing: Perfect. If legal needs to redact anything, loop them in. Otherwise we'll send the breakout as an attachment and offer a review call.

Maria F: Thanks team. I'll update the customer after I confirm the audit clause. :thumbsup:
